resources.string: Optional app blocking: detects the package of the app whose window opens and returns Home when your timer or schedule blocks it. Does not retrieve screen text, passwords or window contents. App events are not stored or transmitted. Settings and calling apps remain accessible. You can turn this service off in Android Accessibility settings.

Optional screen-aware blocking reads supported Brave address bars and YouTube screen controls to enforce website rules and Shorts timers. Screen access is limited to these apps. No passwords, browsing history or screen contents are saved or transmitted. Matching browser pages are covered while browser controls remain usable. For web Shorts it checks labelled player controls and requests Pause when available. Native YouTube Shorts uses Back or Home. Disable it anytime in Accessibility settings.
